Service & Support The Service Provider must own 30% of the bid quantity of vehicles in Service Provider’s name or in the name of the proprietor / partner of the Service Provider. Necessary documents relating to proof of ownership will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such Service Provider owned vehicles will be part of the fleet to be deployed by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 12. Service & Support The Service Provider is required to have at least 40 % of the required manpower on service provider’s payroll for at least one year. Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 13.
